about: The tutorial's play areas (Karl, 2026-11-12: after the crew bus drops you at the mine, the mining part happens inside a set area; go out of it and you are asked to go back, and nothing done out there counts). A step of the induction (Story/Tutorial/Induction.json) or of a Ministry duty (Story/Duties/Quarry.json) names its area with "area": colony (the penal colony and its bus stop at the gate) or quarry (the Ministry Quarry's works, the mine face and its bus stop). Each area is a circle round its middle, as wide as the place it is built round plus "margin" metres (5 to 200). Leave it and the Ministry's tannoy says one of the area's "lines" (then another every "repeat" seconds, 5 to 120, while you stay out), the orange marker points the way back, and the step waits: no cue done outside counts. Come back in ("slack" metres inside the edge, 0 to 20) and it says "back". Text is ASCII. Game/GameTutorialBounds.cs; docs/sandbox/TUTORIAL.md "Play areas".
speaker: [MINISTRY TANNOY]
